ruleDefinitions.name: Diskshadow Script Mode - Uncommon Script Extension Execution
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects execution of "Diskshadow.exe" in script mode to execute an script with a potentially uncommon extension.
Initial baselining of the allowed extension list is required.

sequences.query: ((process_original_file_name = "diskshadow\.exe" OR process_path = RGX("\\\\diskshadow\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-s\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/s\\ .*"))) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.txt.*"))
